# PerfectCast: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code ac784d3a2d30 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Fan-cast the newest romantasy books: every character, your dream celebrity collage, and what the whole fandom picks. Swoon over and comment on other readers' casts.
**Live:** https://perfectcast.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/perfectcast · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/perfectcast/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py perfectcast` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on branch `forms` (2026-11-07).** Not merged: the live app runs master (old JS build). The
  old source folder `perfectcast/` (web/pages + tools/deploy.py) still exists; retire it only after the merge.
- **Engine = `theme/assets/pc.js` (window.PC)**: `PC.collage` (collage HTML, 4 layouts x 4 tones, CSS `.pc-col` in app.css),
  `PC.mountCrop` (the cropper inside `Dialogs/Crop`), `PC.exportImage` (1080x1350 PNG), `PC.hearts`. Python side:
  `client_code/pc.py` (photo URLs, release lines, share, `need_sign_in`, `upload_file` = Crop dialog + upload_photo).
  `Components/Collage` draws a collage; `Components/Heart` does the swoon call itself; `Components/BookForm` is shared
  by `Pages/Suggest` and `Dialogs/BookEdit` (admin).
- **Photo flow**: file inputs are native `<input type=file>` dom-nodes (not FileLoader) so the browser File goes straight
  to the cropper; the cropped JPEG data URLs go to `upload_photo` (server caps in Photos.py; browser sizes `PC.SHAPES`).
  Photos are served by the `/photo` endpoint; `startup.py` sets `window.APP_API`.
- **Collage editor** (`Pages/CastEdit` + `Items/Slot`): slot items edit their pick dict in place and raise `x-typed`
  (preview redraws) or `x-slot` (structural change: the page redraws the panel). Names autocomplete via `<datalist id=ce-names>`.
- **Display text uses dom-nodes + textContent** (lighter than Labels); `pc.show(node, flag)` toggles `hidden`.
  Item roots are `.pc-item-host` (`display: contents`) inside the old grid classes, so the old CSS layouts still apply.
- **app.css is composed** from the template core + PerfectCast tokens/skin + the old pages' CSS (facelifted); deliberate
  exceptions are marked `design-ok` (collage tones = the brand's violet/rose/crimson, film-strip sprockets, 11px labels).
- Router: guests see Books + Stars in the header; the phone tab bar is members only. Redirects rewrite the address.
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` only (every address as guest / new member / admin + 4 dialogs). Demo data loads itself on
  the first `get_shelf`, so a fresh database has books.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **books**: key:str, title:str, author:str, series:str, series_no:num, release:date, blurb:str, tropes:obj, spice:num, cover→photos, status:str, submitted_by→users, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Books, DemoData, Photos, Shelf
- **castings**: key:str, user→users, character→characters, book→books, caption:str, layout:str, tone:str, hearts:num, hidden:bool, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Books, Casting, DemoData, Shelf
- **characters**: key:str, book→books, name:str, role:str, blurb:str, position:num, status:str, submitted_by→users, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Books, Casting, DemoData, Shelf
- **comments**: casting→castings, user→users, body:str, created:dt, hidden:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Casting, DemoData, Shelf
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **hearts**: user→users, casting→castings, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Casting, DemoData, Shelf
- **photos**: owner→users, key:str, image:media, thumb:media, label:str, kind:str, size:num, created:dt, hidden:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Books, Casting, DemoData, Photos
- **picks**: casting→castings, character→characters, user→users, star_name:str, star_key:str, photo→photos, note:str, position:num, is_demo:bool · used in Books, Casting, DemoData, Photos, Shelf
- **reports**: user→users, casting→castings, comment→comments, reason:str, note:str, status:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Books, Casting, DemoData
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, bio:str · used in Admin, DemoData, Shelf

## Biggest files (read these in parts)

`theme/assets/app.css` 1295, `anvil.yaml` 686, `server_code/Books.py` 304, `server_code/Shelf.py` 292, `server_code/seo_routes.py` 258, `server_code/DemoData.py` 250, `server_code/Casting.py` 250, `theme/assets/pc.js` 230

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
